clauses.requirement: The communication form for approval (Annex 1, item 12) shall state whether approval is granted, extended, refused or withdrawn, with the entries that do not apply struck out.
The communication form (Annex 1, item 13) shall state yes or no on whether approval is granted for devices to be used only on vehicles already in use, striking out what does not apply.
The communication form (Annex 1, item 14) shall state the place where it was issued.
The communication form (Annex 1, item 15) shall state the date of issue.
The communication form (Annex 1, item 16) shall bear the signature of the responsible authority representative.

The communication form (Annex 1, item 17) shall state that the list of documents deposited with the Type Approval Authority that granted approval is annexed to the communication and may be obtained on request.

If a rear registration plate illuminating lamp is used (Part D), its field of visibility shall conform to Figures A2-IV, with the horizontal and vertical angles given in the vertical section and horizontal section figures.

If a rear registration plate illuminating lamp is used, the field-of-visibility angles in Table A2-4 shall be met: they relate only to the relative positions of the lamp and the registration plate space; the plate's visibility when mounted on the vehicle remains subject to national regulations; the angles take account of partial occultation by the lamp and shall be adhered to in the directions of most occultation; the lamp shall reduce partly occulted areas to the minimum strictly necessary.
